rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something biases results or makes them lean toward a particular side.

example.english: The wording of this questionnaire can skew the results toward one side.
example.traditional: 呢份問卷嘅問題設計，會令結果偏向支持嗰一邊。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 man6 gyun2 ge3 man6 tai4 cit3 gai3 wui6 ling6 git3 gwo2 pin1 hoeng3 zi1 ci4 go2 jat1 bin1

rows.note: Use this when an object lies or ends up slanting to one side.

example.english: The uneven table made the glass skew to one side.
example.traditional: 張枱唔平，塊玻璃歪咗一邊。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 ci4 m4 ping4 faai3 bo1 lei4 waai1 zo2 jat1 bin1

rows.note: Use this specifically when a person moves sideways or sidles along.

example.english: The alley is so narrow that we have to skew sideways to get through.
example.traditional: 條巷太窄，我哋要側身行先過到去。
example.jyutping: tiu4 hong6 taai3 zaak3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zak1 san1 haang4 sin1 gwo3 dou3 heoi3
